description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest .NET framework.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal explicitly requires upgrading to the latest framework before cloud-native migration tasks.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 and update project structure/build configuration to support the upgraded runtime while preserving existing service behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native service modernization requires replacing non-Azure messaging dependencies with managed Azure messaging services.
tasks.requirements: Migrate application messaging workflows from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus using Azure-native patterns and maintain equivalent alert publishing behavior.

tasks.description: Adopt Azure-native configuration and identity patterns.
tasks.reason: Modern cloud-native services require externalized configuration and managed identity-based authentication.
tasks.requirements: Externalize non-secret application settings to Azure App Configuration and move service authentication to Managed Identity for Azure service access.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in modernization plans to reduce known vulnerability risk before release.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities to the minimum patched versions; if major version upgrades are required, document risk and verify build/tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The project modernization goal explicitly requires deployment to Azure using a cloud-native target.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the upgraded and transformed application to Azure Container Apps using existing or designated Azure resources and validate runtime health in Azure.
